result.topic_en: Lists of angular readings, plus a calculation for a small geometric figure (B, C, A) comparing a measured distance BA with a theoretical value from the formula 19(1/2 − 1/√(8n²−4)) for refractive indices n = 3/2 and n = 1.52.

methods.what: Formula for the distance BA as a function of the refractive index n: 19(1/2 − 1/√(8n² − 4))
Evaluation of the formula for n = 3/2, giving the theoretical BA = 4.422
Evaluation of the formula for n = 1.52 (n² = 2.3104, 8n² − 4 = 14.4832, 1/√ = 0.26276), giving BA = 4.5076
Comparison of measured segment lengths with the theoretical value of BA
